saved: Connection order saved. Gateways get it at their next check.
failed: The connection order was not saved. Try again.
loadError: Could not load the connection order. Try again.

wireguard-wss.name: Network that blocks VPNs (port 443)
wireguard-wss.hint: WireGuard inside a web connection, for Wi-Fi that only lets the web through.

amneziawg.name: Network that recognises VPNs (AmneziaWG)
amneziawg.hint: For networks that spot and stop VPNs. Needs the AmneziaWG app.

list.label: Ways to connect, in the order they are tried
list.help: The first is tried first. If it does not connect in a few seconds, the next one is tried. Switch a way off to stop using it.
list.notRunning: The gateway is not running it now.

forced.label: Force only the first
forced.hint: Only {{method}} is used, with no fallback to the others.
forced.none: Switch on at least one way to connect.

blocked.title_one: 1 device would have no way to connect
blocked.title_other: {{count}} devices would have no way to connect
blocked.body: Their gateway does not run any of the chosen ways. Choose a way the gateway runs, or turn it on there first.

reimport.title_one: 1 device must download its profile again
reimport.title_other: {{count}} devices must download their profile again
reimport.body: The way these devices connect now is no longer in the order: {{devices}}. They stop connecting until their person downloads a profile for another way and imports it in the app.

org.title: Connection order
org.body: Which way phones and computers try first, and what comes next. Lines and devices can use their own order.
org.onlyAdmin: Only the organisation owner or an administrator can change the connection order.
org.membersHint: People can set the order, or force one way, for their own devices, inside what is allowed here. An administrator can lock a line or a device.

device.title: Connection order
device.body: How this device reaches the network.
device.profileMethod: The profile on this device is made for {{method}}.
device.noPath: No way of this order is one the gateway runs. The device cannot connect.
device.lockedNote: An administrator locked this setting. Only an administrator can change it.
device.readOnly: Only an administrator can change this, or the person who owns the device when members can choose.
device.lockHint: People cannot change the order of this device.
device.lockHintLine: People cannot change the order of this device. Line {{line}} has its own lock.
